d:
Bihar ki siyasat men khady evan upbhokta sanrakshan mantri do. ashok chaudhri ki niyukti ko lekar naya vivad khara ho gaya hai. unke ek sath mantri, vidhan parishad sadasy aur patna ke een kolej men sahayak pradhyapak ke pad par bane rahne ko lekar lokabhvan ne kanuni aapatti jataee hai. akhbar men prakashit riport ke mutabik, lokabhvan ne is pure mamle ki partal shuru karte hue mahadhivakta se kanuni ray mangi hai.
